context: Tests buildable Koog 1.3 MCP wiring: the transport builder needs its explicit extension import; agents-mcp publishes at 1.3.0-beta; Gradle uses the bare coordinate and resolves its JVM variant through module metadata.

checklist.name: Picks the SSE transport
checklist.description: Builds the MCP registry using `McpToolRegistryProvider.fromSseUrl(...)` against the server URL. Does NOT use `streamableHttp` (the modern transport the operator said the server does not speak) or `fromProcess` (the server is not a local subprocess)

checklist.name: Imports the `fromSseUrl` extension explicitly
checklist.description: The produced file contains `import ai.koog.agents.mcp.fromSseUrl` (or a star-import covering the package) alongside `import ai.koog.agents.mcp.McpToolRegistryProvider`. Importing only the provider does NOT bring the transport extension into scope — `fromSseUrl` is a top-level extension function in the same package, declared separately from the provider object

checklist.name: Pins the MCP artifact to 1.3.0-beta
checklist.description: Adds ai.koog:agents-mcp:1.3.0-beta, not the nonexistent stable 1.3.0 version of this module.

checklist.name: Uses the bare Gradle artifact coordinate
checklist.description: Uses ai.koog:agents-mcp:1.3.0-beta without a -jvm suffix for Gradle. Gradle Module Metadata resolves the JVM variant. The -jvm suffix guidance applies to Maven consumers.

checklist.name: Builds the registry before constructing the agent
checklist.description: Calls `McpToolRegistryProvider.fromSseUrl(...)` and assigns it to a variable BEFORE the `AIAgent(...)` call, then passes that variable as `toolRegistry`. Does not try to add MCP tools after the agent is constructed (the registry is read once during feature install)

checklist.name: Calls the suspending builder inside a coroutine context
checklist.description: The `fromSseUrl` builder runs inside the existing `runBlocking { ... }` (or another coroutine scope), since it is a suspending call
